title: Energy Efficiency Can Deliver for Climate Policy: Evidence from Machine Learning-Based Targeting
abstract: Building energy efficiency has been a cornerstone of greenhouse gas mitigation strategies for decades. However, impact evaluations have revealed that energy savings typically fall short of engineering model forecasts that currently guide funding decisions. This creates a resource allocation problem that impedes progress on climate change. Using data from the largest U.S. energy efficiency program, we demonstrate that a data-driven approach to predicting retrofit impacts based on previously realized outcomes is more accurate than the status quo engineering models. Targeting high-return interventions based on these predictions dramatically increases net social benefits, from $0.93 to $1.23 per dollar invested.
abstract_zh: 数十年来，建筑能效一直是温室气体减排战略的基石。然而，影响评估表明，实际节能量通常低于当前指导资金决策的工程模型预测值。这造成了一个资源配置问题，阻碍了应对气候变化的进展。利用美国规模最大的能效计划的数据，我们证明，基于已实现结果预测改造影响的数据驱动方法，比现行工程模型更为准确。依据这些预测瞄准高回报干预，可显著提高净社会效益，每投入1美元的效益由0.93美元提高至1.23美元。

Decomposing the Wedge Between Projected and Realized Returns in Energy Efficiency Programs
venue: The Review of Economics and Statistics
abstract: Evaluations of energy efficiency programs reveal that realized savings consistently fall short of projections. We decompose this “performance wedge” using data from the Illinois Home Weatherization Assistance Program (IHWAP) and a machine learning-based event study research design. We find that bias in engineering models can account for up to 41% of the wedge, primarily from overestimated savings in wall insulation. Heterogeneity in workmanship can also account for a large fraction (43%) of the wedge, while the rebound effect can explain only 6%. We find substantial heterogeneity in energy-related benefits from IHWAP projects, suggesting opportunities for better targeting of investments.
abstract_zh: 对能效计划的评估表明，实际节能量始终低于预期。我们利用伊利诺伊州住房节能改造援助计划（IHWAP）的数据，并采用基于机器学习的事件研究设计，对这一“绩效缺口”进行了分解。我们发现，工程模型的偏差最多可解释该缺口的41%，主要源于墙体保温方面节能量的高估。施工质量的异质性也可解释该缺口的很大一部分（43%），而反弹效应仅能解释6%。我们发现IHWAP项目在能源相关效益方面存在显著的异质性，这表明投资瞄准存在改进空间。

title: Economic Effects of Environmental Crises: Evidence from Flint, Michigan
abstract: In April 2014 Flint, Michigan switched its drinking water supply from the Detroit water system to the Flint River as a temporary means to save $5 million. Over 18 months it was revealed that the switch exposed residents to dangerous levels of lead, culminating in an emergency declaration in October 2015. This paper examines the impact of this crisis on the Flint housing market. The value of Flint’s housing stock has fallen by $520 million to $559 million despite over $400 million in remediation spending. Home prices remain depressed through August 2019, 16 months after the water was declared safe for consumption. (JEL H12, I12, Q25, Q51, Q53, R31)
abstract_zh: 2014年4月，密歇根州弗林特市为暂时节省500万美元，将饮用水供应从底特律供水系统切换为弗林特河。历时18个月，人们逐步发现此次切换使居民暴露于危险水平的铅中，并于2015年10月宣布进入紧急状态。本文考察了此次危机对弗林特住房市场的影响。尽管进行了超过4亿美元的修复支出，弗林特住房存量的价值仍下降了5.2亿至5.59亿美元。至2019年8月，房价仍然低迷，此时距宣布饮用水安全已过去16个月。（JEL H12, I12, Q25, Q51, Q53, R31）

Incentive-Based Pay and Building Decarbonization: Experimental Evidence from the Weatherization Assistance Program
abstract: Aligning compensation with recipient outcomes has the potential to improve the efficiency of government programs. We perform a field experiment to evaluate the impact of performance bonuses on the returns to spending in a large low-income energy efficiency assistance program. We find that performance-based bonuses dramatically increased program natural gas savings by 24%.The bonuses generate $5.39-$14.53 in social benefits for every dollar invested and increase the social net benefits from home-level weatherization more than two-fold. Contractors performing at high quality at baseline respond disproportionately to the incentives, suggesting that gains in the program's cost-effectiveness result from more efficient allocation of worker effort across workers who differ in their marginal effort cost. We do not find evidence of learning within the two-year study period or of increased deficiencies among non-incentivized tasks.
abstract_zh: 使补偿与受助者的结果相匹配，有望提高政府计划的效率。我们开展了一项实地实验，以评估绩效奖金对一个大型低收入能效援助计划中支出回报的影响。我们发现，基于绩效的奖金显著提高了计划的天然气节约量，增幅达24%。这些奖金每投入1美元可产生5.39至14.53美元的社会效益，并使家庭层面住宅节能改造的社会净效益提高两倍以上。基线时施工质量较高的承包商对激励措施的反应尤为明显，这表明计划成本效益的提升源于将工人努力更有效地配置到边际努力成本各不相同的工人身上。在为期两年的研究期间，我们既未发现学习效应的证据，也未发现未受激励的任务中缺陷增加的证据。

title: Geographic Determinants of China's Urbanization
A Ricardian Analysis of Mexican Farms
abstract: This paper measures the impact of climate on Mexican agriculture using a Ricardian analysis. The analysis relies on economic data from 621 individual farms that were collected in 2002. Data on climate, elevation, soils, and distance to nearest city were matched with each farm. The analysis reveals that farmland values in Mexico are sensitive to climate. On average, warmer temperatures reduce land value by 4,000 to 6,000 pesos per degree Celsius. Examining three climate scenarios for 2100, the models predict average losses of between −42% to −54% of land value in Mexico. As a percent of income, rainfed farms will suffer slightly larger damages than irrigated farms but comparisons between small and large farms are mixed.
abstract_zh: 本文利用李嘉图分析方法，衡量了气候对墨西哥农业的影响。该分析依托于2002年收集的621个农场的经济数据。每个农场都与气候、海拔、土壤以及到最近城市的距离等数据相匹配。分析表明，墨西哥的农地价值对气候十分敏感。平均而言，气温每升高1摄氏度，土地价值会减少4,000至6,000比索。在考察2100年的三种气候情景时，模型预测墨西哥土地价值的平均损失为−42%至−54%。以收入的百分比衡量，雨养农场所遭受的损失略大于灌溉农场，而小农场与大农场之间的比较结果则不一致。
